title: Staying Healthy
setting: A small house with a garden, a bright kitchen and a bathroom.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

sentences.en: Anna and Dan want to be healthy.
sentences.zh: 安娜和丹想要保持健康。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper), now in sports clothes and trainers, stand smiling in the bright kitchen.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the couple ready for sport; the wish to be healthy can only be guessed.
sentences.narration: Anna and Dan, now in sports clothes and trainers, stand smiling in the bright kitchen.

sentence_targets.en: physically well and not suffering from illness

sentences.en: They exercise with music in their ears.
sentences.zh: 他们戴着耳机听着音乐锻炼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper), in sports clothes, jog in the garden wearing small earphones.
sentences.narration: Anna and Dan, in sports clothes, jog in the garden wearing small earphones.

sentence_targets.en: One of the organs on your head used for hearing.
Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.

sentences.en: For breakfast, they eat fruit and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 早饭他们吃水果和蔬菜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) sit at the kitchen table with plates of fruit and fresh vegetables.
sentences.narration: Anna and Dan sit at the kitchen table with plates of fruit and fresh vegetables.

sentence_targets.en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food.
a plant or plant part eaten as food

sentences.en: Dan puts lots of salt on his eggs.
sentences.zh: 丹在鸡蛋上撒了很多盐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) shakes a salt shaker hard over a plate of eggs, making a little white pile.
sentences.narration: Dan shakes a salt shaker hard over a plate of eggs, making a little white pile.

sentence_targets.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food

sentences.en: Anna's eyes go wide: “That is dangerous!”
sentences.zh: 安娜瞪大眼睛：“那很危险！”
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) stares with wide eyes and raises a hand in warning at the salt shaker in the hand of Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper).
sentences.draw_note: Shows Anna's wide eyes and her warning gesture; her words can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Anna stares with wide eyes and raises a hand in warning at the salt shaker in the hand of Dan.

sentence_targets.en: Likely to cause harm, injury, or serious problems.
one of the two body parts used for seeing

sentences.en: Here is a fact: water is the best drink.
sentences.zh: 有个事实：水是最好的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) hands a big glass of water to Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) at the kitchen table and pushes the salt away.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Anna giving Dan water instead of salt; the 'fact' itself can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Anna hands a big glass of water to Dan at the kitchen table and pushes the salt away.

sentence_targets.en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
Something known or proved to be true.

sentences.en: Before bed, he never forgets his toothbrush and toothpaste.
sentences.zh: 睡觉前，他从不忘记牙刷和牙膏。
sentences.scene_prompt: In the bathroom at night, Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) puts toothpaste on his toothbrush.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Dan brushing his teeth at night; 'never forgets' can't be shown.
sentences.narration: In the bathroom at night, Dan puts toothpaste on his toothbrush.

sentence_targets.en: A substance used with a toothbrush to clean teeth.
to fail to remember a fact, person, or experience
A small brush used for cleaning your teeth.

sentences.en: With a clean mouth, Dan goes to sleep.
sentences.zh: 嘴巴干干净净，丹去睡觉了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) sleeps peacefully in bed with a small smile.
sentences.narration: Dan sleeps peacefully in bed with a small smile.

sentence_targets.en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking
to rest with eyes closed and awareness reduced
